Backend Engineer (Python) — Example Co, Bengaluru

We're looking for a backend engineer to build and scale our payments platform.

What you'll do
- Design REST APIs and microservices in Python (FastAPI) and Go
- Own PostgreSQL schemas and Redis caching
- Build event-driven pipelines on Kafka
- Deploy on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes and Terraform; CI/CD with GitHub Actions
- Improve observability with Prometheus and Grafana

Requirements
- 2+ years building backend services in Python
- Strong SQL and PostgreSQL experience
- Experience with Kafka or similar streaming systems
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and AWS
- Nice to have: GraphQL, Elasticsearch
